test_df_describe: test the DataFrame.describe() method with multiple column types including float, int, bool, string, datetime, date, and time
test_df_describe_nested: test the DataFrame.describe() method with nested struct and list column types
test_df_describe_custom_percentiles: test the DataFrame.describe() method with custom percentiles parameter
test_df_describe_no_percentiles: test the DataFrame.describe() method with no percentiles to exclude percentile statistics
test_df_describe_empty_column: test the DataFrame.describe() method on an empty column with no rows
